items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Quank would play with us all the week... he played with, with the Olympic band

ctx.x: Dave, Dave play climate, Dave DePass, and Arnall, he was very good, see, but a drummer, we wanted another drummer, so, we got Quank, known as Ernest Prakhan, we call him Quank, see,
